types.name: InViewTitleProps
types.doc: A section title that reveals itself once it scrolls into view. `blur` sharpens word by word and suits most headings; `word` and `line` rise out of a clip for editorial pages; `tracking` opens tight letter spacing; `wipe` uncovers the title from left to right through a soft edge. Pass `lines` to set the breaks for `line`, and `once={false}` to replay on every entry. Titles that are already above the viewport show immediately, and server rendered titles appear on their own if scripts are slow.
